name: Tam huu
summary: Tam hữu is a Trà Quế roll of one cooked land shrimp, a slice of boiled pork, and a stalk of mint, tied with a blanched scallion leaf and dipped in sweet-sour fish sauce. The bite is mint, scallion, fatty belly, and sweet shrimp.
origin: Trà Quế vegetable village, Hội An.
taste: Mint, scallion, fatty belly pork, and sweet shrimp.
howToEat: Eat one roll with the sweet-sour fish sauce. The three parts are shrimp, pork, and the herb.
seoTitle: Tam huu — the three-part roll in Tra Que
seoDescription: Tam hữu in Trà Quế is one shrimp, a slice of boiled pork, and mint, tied with scallion and dipped in sweet-sour fish sauce.
